result.detail: Splitting associated_with into high (2,527 edges with genetic, somatic-mutation or known-drug evidence), low (4,379: literature, expression, animal model or pathway) and none (8,524) raises RGCN from 0.475294/0.397807 to 0.499049/0.439972 on the same fixed held-out set. Withholding was verified at 3,086 of 3,086 test edges, three seeds. This was the largest design gain measured for the relation-aware GNN to that point.

title: Open Targets evidence classes as relation subtypes: +0.024 macro under RGCN
